# Site rules

Lead line: I build AI-run marketing systems for brands.

## Writing
- No em dashes. No semicolons in prose. En dashes only in number and date ranges.
- No emoji. Blog content is posts or writing, never essays.
- No AI rhythm: avoid "Not X. Y.", stacked short fragments, tidy closing lines, empty openers.
- Writing starts from Sai's own words. Real numbers and real opinions only.

## Design
- No numbered eyebrows, pill labels, tag chips or boxed stat cards.
- Prefer plain editorial typography, hairlines and clear hierarchy.
- Every button must be readable in every state.

## Quality
- Content must never wait on an animation. Loaders have a hard time cap.
- No sideways scroll from 375px up. Zero console errors.
- Images are sized and compressed before publishing.
- Internal reports never go in the published folder.
- No AI attribution anywhere.

Run `python3 .github/scripts/scan.py` before every push to main.
